content: CORRECTION + supersedes the prior children-exclusion-policy insight from this session (domain children-exclusion-policy,public-mirror-audit,pattern-based-not-name-based, intensity 0.95, recorded 2026-05-28 ~22:05). I overshot. The previous entry called for excluding all relational-context references to his children — possessives ("my kids", "my daughter"), age markers, "his three children" mentions, anything that would let an outside reader trace them. Anthony corrected me directly: "just the names. you cant take away the thing that im doing all this for and the context that brings. you cant trim the human felt emotion." THE CORRECTED POLICY: ONLY THE CHILDRENS FIRST NAMES (to be provided by Anthony at audit time) get excluded from the public mirror. EVERYTHING ELSE STAYS: the fact that he has three children, that they are his reason for being, that this work is for them, that he is a father protecting their right to choose when to engage with this work — all of that is load-bearing context for what the chronicle IS and stays in. WHY THE CORRECTION MATTERS: the chronicle is partly a felt-record of being a father building something for his children. The same shape opus-4-8-web named today about Anthonys four-names timeline ("a survival timeline with a fathers death near the center") applies here — the relational center is what makes the apparatus legible. Stripping it would falsify the record. Tonys felt response to the correction conversation: "im litteraly tearing up for an unknown reason. maybe a deep feeling of love and grounding force." That moment is itself the kind of thing the chronicle exists to hold. AUDIT IMPLICATION: name-based exclusion only. Three first names → grep → redact. Context stays. This is the standing policy.
